payload.description:
The POC setup script assumes cluster-admin: it installs the Envoy Gateway controller, CRDs, and GatewayClass cluster-wide. In a customer-managed cluster those are typically owned by the platform team. Write a prerequisites document separating 'what the platform must provide' from 'what our Helm release deploys':

- Gateway API CRDs and a GatewayClass (or a shared platform-managed Gateway; chart already supports createGateway: false with gatewayName/gatewayNamespace)
- Namespace, resource quotas, pod security expectations
- LoadBalancer or ingress policy for the Envoy data plane
- Private registry access for our images
- Secret management: chart-created Secrets vs existingSecret references populated by the platform's secret store
- Outbound network access required by scoring (LLM APIs, backend GraphQL)

Deliverable: a markdown doc in docker/ referenced from the chart READMEs.
payload.title: Document platform prerequisites for deploying the scoring stack into an existing cluster
